description: Gold query set for the embedding-model comparison harness (roadmap #27, analysis/embedding_compare.py). Each entry pairs a natural-language query with the slug(s) of the corpus article(s) that most directly answer it, so a candidate embedder can be scored on precision@k / recall@k / MRR against the pinned sbert-mpnet-v2 (decision D2). This file is text-free (queries + public article slugs only), so it is committed like eval/questions.json. It is a deliberately small starter set — expand it (more queries, more relevant_slugs per query) to tighten the comparison. relevant_slugs must match slugs in data/manifest.json.

queries.query: Is Europe finally moving toward a shared fiscal union, a Hamiltonian moment?
What is Warren Buffett's bet on the Japanese trading houses, and does value investing still work?
Why did China block Jack Ma's Ant Group IPO?
What drove the GameStop short squeeze and the gamma swarm?
Is the recent inflation spike real or just a statistical artifact in the CPI?
